description: This file provides utility methods for file operations such as reading file contents into a string or list, with error checking for file existence.

classes.name: FileUtils
classes.description: A utility class that offers static methods to read file contents either as a string or as a list of lines.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file and returns it as a single String, appending newline characters.

methods.name: readFileToList
methods.description: Reads the specified file line by line and returns a List of strings, each representing a line.
